# RCS Number Checker API

> Official CheckNumber code examples for a bulk, asynchronous API used to verify whether phone numbers have RCS enabled.

Base URL: https://api.checknumber.ai
Authentication: X-API-Key request header

## Workflow

1. Submit: POST https://api.checknumber.ai/v1/tasks with `file` and `task_type=rcs`.
2. Poll: POST https://api.checknumber.ai/v1/gettasks with `task_id`.
3. Download: retrieve `result_url` after status becomes `exported`.

## Variants

- `task_type=rcs` — RCS Number Checker: https://docs.checknumber.ai/rcs-checker

## Pricing

Current terms: https://checknumber.ai/pricing
Balance endpoint: GET https://api.checknumber.ai/v1/balance

## Docs

- Canonical documentation: https://docs.checknumber.ai/rcs-checker
- Dashboard and API keys: https://platform.checknumber.ai
